title: Getting started with Hive Pal: account, apiary and hives in 5 minutes
summary: A walkthrough of your first few minutes in Hive Pal, the free, open-source beekeeping app. We create an account, set up an apiary with its location and local weather, add hives, arrange them on the apiary minimap, adjust the settings, and take a tour of the dashboard.
